paragraphs: In Bereshit Rabbah 82:5, Rabbi Yudan, Rabbi Aivu and Rabbi Meshin bar Nagri report in the name of Rabbi Yochanan. Some read bar Nagdi.

notes.text: The printed locator פ״פבד remains unresolved. The patronymic is also reported as bar Nagdi.

The saved whole Torat Emet Bereshit Rabbah82:5 scalar lists Yudan, Ayvu and Mashyan ben Nagri [Nagdi] in Yochanan’s name. It supplies the matching passage and variant alongside source פ״פבד, superseding the older chapter84 suggestion without proving a dalet/he printing history. Hyman’s Meshin/bar and the edition’s Mashyan/ben remain distinguished; no identity is merged.

Hyman’s printed notice (vol. III, p. 911) cites Bereshit Rabbah 82:5. The supplied Hebrew has the malformed locator פ״פבד. The consulted passage names the three joint reporters in Yochanan’s name and reads Mashyan ben Nagri, with Nagdi in brackets. The translation keeps the name and patronymic as Hyman gives them.
